scripts.build: npm run build --workspace functions && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace functions
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-boardgame --only auth,database,functions
scripts.test:services: node tests/integration.mjs && node tests/timebomb-integration.mjs && node tests/decorum-integration.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-boardgame --only auth,database,functions "npm run test:services"
